name: amda-skill
description: Frameworks for enterprise AI go-to-market, packaged as installable agent skills. Decision governance and pilot production-readiness.

plugins.name: amda-decision-router
plugins.description: Two skills. amda-decision-router sorts marketing and GTM decisions into three AI governance zones by reversibility, exposure and frequency. pilot-trap-auditor places an enterprise AI pilot on a five-stage arc and names which of six infrastructure gaps are still open. Both ship with labelled evaluation cases.
